description: This file defines the Target interface within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.connectivity package. It specifies the contract for a connection target, including methods to retrieve address, topics, QoS, authorization context, acknowledgment labels, header and payload mappings, and JSON serialization. It also contains nested classes defining JSON field constants for configuration.

classes.name: Target.JsonFields
classes.description: Defines JSON schema fields for serializing and deserializing Target configuration properties.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns the address for the configured type of signals of this target.

methods.name: getOriginalAddress
methods.description: Returns the original address (before placeholders were resolved).

methods.name: withAddress
methods.description: Creates a copy of this object with the target address replaced.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Returns set of topics that should be published via this target.

methods.name: getQos
methods.description: Returns the optional QoS value of this target, applicable for certain connection types.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Returns the Authorization Context of this Target; overrides connection-level context if set.

methods.name: getIssuedAcknowledgementLabel
methods.description: Defines an optional label for automatically issued acknowledgements.

methods.name: getHeaderMapping
methods.description: Returns optional header mapping for outgoing messages.

methods.name: getPayloadMapping
methods.description: Returns payload mappings to be applied for messages sent on this target.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Target to a JSON object (non-hidden fields by default).

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Target to a JSON object with specified schema version and field selection.
